mapper.insert: insert into orders (customer_id, address_id, station_id, delivery_station_id, settle_station_id, delivery_staff_id, source, status, payment_method, payment_status, total_amount, water_amount, deposit_amount, delivery_fee, floor_fee, receiver_name, receiver_phone, address_snapshot, address_snapshot_lat, address_snapshot_lng, guard_info, delivery_time_request, special_note, delivery_bucket_qty, return_bucket_qty, barrel_discrepancy, barrel_discrepancy_note, first_barrel_order, quantity, create_time, update_time, due_date, idempotency_key, request_digest) values (#{customerId}, #{addressId}, #{stationId}, #{deliveryStationId}, #{settleStationId}, #{deliveryStaffId}, #{source}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentStatus}, #{totalAmount}, #{waterAmount}, #{depositAmount}, IFNULL(#{deliveryFee}, 0.00), IFNULL(#{floorFee}, 0.00), #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{addressSnapshot}, #{addressSnapshotLat}, #{addressSnapshotLng}, #{guardInfo}, #{deliveryTimeRequest}, #{specialNote}, #{deliveryBucketQty}, #{returnBucketQty}, #{barrelDiscrepancy}, #{barrelDiscrepancyNote}, #{firstBarrelOrder}, #{quantity}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{dueDate}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest})
mapper.select: select o.station_id as stationId, s.name as stationName from orders o inner join station s on o.station_id = s.id where o.customer_id = #{customerId} order by o.create_time desc limit 1
